mockExam.title: Mock exams
mockExam.listDescription: Complete a timed Goethe A2 simulation. Finished tasks and modules lock permanently for the attempt.
mockExam.almostMessage: Keep practising and retry when you are ready.
mockExam.provisionalSpeakingNote: Speaking includes Teil 1–2 only (maximum 12 points). Teil 3 and pronunciation are not yet scored, so the overall result is provisional.
mockExam.lockWarning: Exercises unlock in order. A submitted exercise locks and cannot be reopened.
mockExam.pendingCanLock: AI grading is pending. You can still lock this module and retry grading from the results.
mockExam.resetConfirm: Reset this mock exam and remove all saved answers?
mockExam.timeExpired: {skill} time expired. The module was locked with your current answers.
mockExam.overviewDescription: Complete each timed module separately. Leaving does not pause its countdown.
mockExam.allLocked: All modules are locked. Your result is ready.
mockExam.finishAll: Lock all four modules to view the result.
mockExam.deleteSetConfirm: Delete {title}, its saved attempt, and locally generated content?
mockExam.generateSetDescription: Create a new Goethe A2 set with AI-generated tasks and Docker-based listening audio.
mockExam.preflightDescription: All three services must be ready before the mock exam set can be generated.
mockExam.preflightBlocked: Resolve the unavailable tools, then run the checks again.
mockExam.pipelineRunningDescription: Modules run one at a time. Listening includes a separate audio job for every Teil.
mockExam.pipelineFailedDescription: Completed jobs are saved. Retry continues from the failed job.
mockExam.pipelineDoneDescription: The generated set is ready and has been added to your local library.
mockExam.aiOverviewDescription: A concise review of strengths and areas to focus on.
mockExam.aiOverviewEmpty: Generate an overview when you want combined feedback across all four modules.

mockExam.reviewUnavailableDescription: Finish this mock exam before opening its exercise review.
